post.description:
Upload a PDF resume and start reading its candidate profile.

Verifies the PDF is a resume/CV before creating a workspace, then waits for profile extraction.
There is no detached extraction task. Read `GET /api/searches/{run_id}` after
this response for the extracted profile or recorded extraction error.

Job searching starts only after you review and confirm your profile and search
preferences using `PUT /api/searches/{run_id}/confirm-profile`.

201.description: The workspace ID after extraction finishes. Read its snapshot for the profile or extraction error.

422.description: Invalid PDF, unreadable text, or document not identified as a resume/CV.

503.description: The resume/CV detection service is unavailable or returned an invalid result.

post.description: Resume the latest linked search, or explicitly create a new search.
Start steps 2 and 3 after the user confirms the profile search inputs.
Append new postings using the existing profile and edited search preferences.

delete.description: Flush the active run and all generated files when starting over.

get.description: Return worldwide city, region, and country suggestions from Photon.

resume.title: Resume
resume.description: Your resume as a PDF file, up to 5 MB.

tech_skills.title: Tech Skills
tech_skills.description: List of Familiar Programming Languages or Frameworks (e.g. Python, C++, JavaScript, Java, ReactJS, NodeJS)

soft_skills.title: Soft Skills
soft_skills.description: List of Soft skills (e.g. Responsibility, Curiosity, Leadership)

years_of_experience.title: Years Of Experience
years_of_experience.description: Completed years of paid professional employment, excluding degree duration, coursework and personal/academic projects. Avoid double-counting overlapping dates. Do not round internships up to full years.

career_level.title: Career Level
career_level.description: Career level supported by professional scope and tenure, not degree level or technology keywords.

experience_evidence.title: Experience Evidence
experience_evidence.description: Brief resume evidence for employment tenure and responsibility; explicitly identify internships and academic work.

preferred_domains.title: Preferred Domains
preferred_domains.description: Domain of Interest (e.g. AI Engineer, Software Engineer, Full Stack Web Developer)

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: A brief summary of candidate's professional bacground and academic focus
